title: Airport check-in — show documents
prompt: What do you show at the airport check-in?
hint: Name both documents: passport and ticket.

title: Seat preference response
prompt: How do you say you want a window seat at check-in?
hint: Say exactly: 'I prefer a window seat.'

sample: They gave the passenger a boarding pass.
